a2aModeDesc: Control how agents communicate in each conversation.
a2aMaxRoundsDesc: Limit how many times agents can automatically hand work to another agent for one user task, preventing repetitive chat and runaway cost.
a2aMaxRoundsHelp: One round is one automatic agent-to-agent handoff. The default is 12, the allowed range is 1–50, and changes apply to the next collaboration task.
a2aMaxRoundsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.
a2aCallTimeoutMinutesDesc: Limit how long one agent-to-agent call can run while it continues producing output and using tools.
a2aCallTimeoutMinutesHelp: The default is 5 minutes, with an allowed range of 1–30 minutes. The full collaboration task defaults to 20 minutes and is never shorter than this per-call timeout.
a2aCallTimeoutMinutesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
